worldcombat.skill.healbell.summary: Rings a chime centred on itself; one cast peals several times, and each peal clears every harmful status effect, including vanilla and mod effects, from the user and all allies inside the radius. It does not heal and leaves no lasting effect.
worldcombat.skill.healbell.use.0: Wipe a whole team's statuses after the foe lands several
worldcombat.skill.healbell.use.1: Wake a sleeping ally and free a paralysed one
worldcombat.skill.healbell.use.2: Clear the team at once when everyone stands close
worldcombat.skill.healbell.description.0: Centred on the user, each peal covers the user and allies within %1$s blocks, and one cast rings %2$s times; every peal clears all harmful status effects (including vanilla and mod effects) from everyone in range. It does not heal and leaves no lasting effect.
worldcombat.skill.healbell.description.1: Another peal follows every %1$s, re-cleansing whoever in range carries a status at that moment; it cannot be used when no one in range has anything to cleanse.
worldcombat.skill.healbell.stance.resona: Long peal: x1.25 radius and one extra ring, at the cost of a longer wind-up and cooldown (one thorough cleanse).
worldcombat.skill.healbell.stance.short: Short peal: faster wind-up and cooldown with the base radius and ring count (a more frequent purge).
worldcombat.skill.healbell.timing: A self move; after %1$s s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP, then recovers for %2$s s with a %4$s s cooldown committed on cast. It can move while casting, and each peal rings from wherever the user stands at that moment.
worldcombat.skill.healbell.preference.re: On: x1.25 radius and one extra ring, but x1.2 wind-up and x1.15 cooldown. Off (short peal): x0.9 wind-up and x0.95 cooldown with the base radius and ring count. Each direction has its moments.
worldcombat.skill.healbell.preference.ai: The bell is worth ringing once at least this many allies (including itself) carry a status; 1 rings at the first case, higher waits for more to be caught together.
Allies within this distance count as being in the bell; lower rings only when they are adjacent, higher rings for allies further out.
worldcombat.skill.healbell.growth.0: From level %1$s, cooldown is reduced by an extra 1 seconds.
worldcombat.skill.healbell.growth.1: From level %1$s, the extra cooldown reduction becomes 2.1 seconds, replacing the earlier reduction.
